raw_response:
I’m 65 this year, and I’ve farmed in Quzhou my whole life, so I won’t do anything too fancy. On the 6 mu that I keep in wheat-maize rotation, I’ll mostly follow the way that has worked before: wheat goes in after autumn land prep, then maize right after wheat harvest with very little delay. Cotton I’ll keep on the other 4.1 mu. The well helps, but pumping costs money, so I won’t water more than needed. I have a big household, but some people work outside, so at busy times I still need to keep labor simple and sometimes hire a little help. The extension guy talks about precise rates, but in real life I still look at the field color, soil moisture, and what nearby farmers are doing. If the crop looks weak, I’d rather topdress a bit more than risk losing yield.
